parsed.narrative: joanna says she has been working on projects and testing out dairy-free dessert recipes for friends and fam. she shares a cake she made recently and explains that it is dairy-free vanilla with strawberry filling and coconut cream frosting. she says she really likes experimenting in the kitchen and that cooking and baking are her creative outlets. she describes making desserts just as delicious while snackin' dairy-free as a rewarding challenge, and says seeing the smiles on everyone's faces when they try it is a total win.

raw_text: {"anchor":"wife","spark":"put on my new stuff suit","wound":"town grows very sickly","fuel":"wife's praise","bridge":"bringing my wife down","echo":"new lace bands","narrative":"he put on his new stuff suit, which his wife said became him most nobly. he was at the office all day, then at noon put on his first laced band and went to kate joyce’s to dinner with his mother, wife, and friends. later he and his wife and mercer bought more lace bands, went to deptford and woolwich, and at woolwich discussed bringing his wife down for a month or two to mr. sheldon’s house. he came back late, wrote letters, and went to bed. the day also notes the newes book, the late victory, the duke of yorke not yet come to towne, and concern that the towne grows very sickly with plague deaths rising."}

raw_text: {"anchor":"three-day walking trip","spark":"long weekend","wound":"empty weekend","fuel":"pride","bridge":"can be on my own","echo":"quiet, enormous","narrative":"the client took a three-day walking trip alone over the long weekend, a trip they had booked weeks ago and had considered cancelling. the first evening in the hostel was very difficult: their stomach was knotted, they could not eat dinner, and they lay listening to other people laughing downstairs. on the second day, the knot loosened by mid-morning and did not come back, and at the summit the client cried for about ten minutes and did not mind. the client said the trip taught them they can be on their own and be all right, and they want to keep the memory as evidence for next time they dread an empty weekend."}

parsed.narrative: the client took a three-day walking trip alone over the long weekend, a trip they had booked weeks ago and had considered cancelling. the first evening in the hostel was very difficult: their stomach was knotted, they could not eat dinner, and they lay listening to other people laughing downstairs. on the second day, the knot loosened by mid-morning and did not come back, and at the summit the client cried for about ten minutes and did not mind. the client said the trip taught them they can be on their own and be all right, and they want to keep the memory as evidence for next time they dread an empty weekend.
